title: THE PIXEL ADAPTER AND THE LOOT
why: Job 86e ship 1: pixWrap runs a vector painter into an art resolution scratch once and caches it hard edged on the tones the painter used, so with the pixel look on every container, body, carcass and the 9 machine wrecks are one cached sprite a frame (opened and closed both). The ground shadow, the dim, the search bar and the wreck smoke stay live.
now: With the pixel look on, crates, lockers, safes, caches, bodies, deer and the machine wrecks draw as crisp pixel sprites; opened ones still dim. Wreck smoke still rises. With the look off nothing changes.
